hypothesis: When resolving a Google Maps short link with only a search query (?q=), Google Maps returns a staticmap centered at the request server IP location (e.g. Nebraska, USA 41.10567, -96.265644 with zoom=6). If link_resolver unconditionally adopts staticmap center, Taiwan POIs are placed in the United States.

When resolving a query-only Google Maps link in Taiwan, Google Maps falls back to city overview coordinates (22.6459648, 120.3109888). Unconditionally trusting staticmap center causes disparate venues across Kaohsiung to share identical dummy coordinates.

Because query-only links receive identical dummy coordinates, Cloudflare D1 batchInsertPois ON CONFLICT(user_id, lat, lng) and frontend SWR mutate treat subsequent different venues as the same POI, causing previous venues to be completely overwritten upon importing new ones.

Mobile Google Maps export concatenates postal code, district, village, street number and venue name into a single dirty query string. Without deterministic regex splitting, UI displays deformed titles like '807高雄市三民區十美里漢口街103號君腿庫飯'.
